component.name: Markup Notes
component.summary: A fast, lightweight, native Markdown note-taking app

description.p: Markup Notes is a distraction-free, native Markdown note-taking application designed for performance, speed, and privacy. Built with Qt6 and Python, it provides instant startup, rich live Markdown formatting, Math / LaTeX equations, Mermaid diagrams, interactive task lists, and seamless Git version control backups.

ul.li: Fast, responsive, native desktop performance without Electron overhead
Instant live Markdown formatting with inline LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams
Distraction-free editing with automatic note saving and folder organization
Built-in Git version control with local history snapshots and GitHub backup
Full dark mode support with modern native Linux desktop integration

screenshot.caption: Markup Notes main 3-pane interface and Markdown editor
Live Markdown formatting with inline task lists and equations

ul.li: Added custom text color and background highlight picker in scratchpad toolbar.
Added multi-line selection support for color formatting with list preservation.
Added hanging indent alignment for multiline lists and checkboxes.
Added dynamic date picker modal and date card insertion.
Added full window zoom shortcuts and UI scaling preference settings.
Added transient auto-hiding scrollbars for cleaner editor aesthetics.
Permanently hidden raw HTML color and highlight tags in the editor.
Fixed caret boundary navigation to jump across hidden color tags atomically.
Fixed artificial word spacing gaps caused by hidden color tags.
Fixed multi-word highlight and text color stripping.
Replaced dated ballot box glyphs with modern vector checkboxes in PDF and HTML export.
Fixed folder deselection when clicking empty space in the sidebar.

description.p: Added keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet modal and universal Markdown editor shortcuts.
Added single-click folder sync, delete confirmation modal, and Lucide UI icons.
